Great — quick notes before the call:
- Our sizing model assumes streaming model token latency ~20-40ms p50 and ~60-90ms p95 on our recommended L7 variant (quantized), per-GPU sustained tokens/sec ~1.2M tokens/sec with batching (depends on seq len).
- For your workload: 150 QPS * 250 tokens = 37.5k tokens/sec steady; peak 320*250=80k tokens/sec -> well within a single 8-GPU Dedicated pool (we estimate ~0.12 of sustained capacity). Realistically you'd start with a 1-2 GPU Dedicated cluster with autoscaling to handle peaks, or hosted with reserved burst.
- Retrieval: we can pipeline RAG so retrieval happens while model streams; add ~50-80ms overhead depending on your endpoint — we'll test end-to-end in the follow-up.
- Concurrency: websocket count ~2,400 aligns with QPS if average think time is ~15s per session — we will simulate this in the load test.

I've attached a quick throughput snapshot and a sample sizing calc (throughput-snapshot.json). During the call I'll walk through assumptions and cost tradeoffs (batching vs latency, quantization options).

Next call details: Thu Jul 30 9:30am PT (invited). I'll have Marissa (solutions engineer) join to run through the numbers.

Rafael
